subject: general
question: What is the time taken by a 450 m long train running at 54 km/h to cross a man standing on a platform?
solution:
Given:

Speed of the train = 54 kmph

Length of the train = 450m

Concept used:

Time × Speed = Distance

While a train crosses a person, it crosses its own length.

Kilometer per hour (kmph) = 3.6 × Meter per second (mps)

Calculation:

54 km/h = 54 ÷ 3.6 = 15 mps

Time taken by the train to cross the man = 450 ÷ 15 = 30 seconds

∴ A 450m long train running at 54 km/h will take 30 seconds to cross a man standing on a platform.
